header.content:
# AI Agent Optimization
Find the waste, then cut it. This dashboard reads **`gen_ai.*` spans** emitted by the kagent crew (namespace `kagent`) and surfaces the three highest-leverage optimization signals:

1. **Token spend by agent** — rank who costs the most; a 20% cut on the top spender beats a 50% cut on a rare one.
2. **Input : output ratio & tools used** — a high input ratio + few distinct tools used = a bloated prompt / unused tool schemas you can trim.
3. **Inefficient loops** — tasks that burned many `call_llm` hops re-sending the same context.

> Re-measure here **before and after** each change. Keep the change only if cost dropped and the eval pass rate (module 05) held. See `docs/06-optimize.md`.

sv-total-tokens.title: Total tokens (crew)
sv-total-tokens.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) | summarize totalTokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) + sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)

sv-llm-calls.title: LLM calls
sv-llm-calls.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and span.name == "call_llm" | summarize llmCalls = count()

sv-tool-calls.title: Tool calls
sv-tool-calls.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool" | summarize toolCalls = count()

sv-tasks.title: Agent tasks
sv-tasks.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and span.name == "call_llm" | summarize tasks = countDistinct(gen_ai.task.id)

md-spend.content: ## 1 · Rank agents by spend — start at the top

spend-bar.title: Token spend by agent
spend-bar.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) | summarize tokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) + sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), by:{service.name} | sort tokens desc

ratio-table.title: Input : output ratio (waste signature)
ratio-table.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) | summarize llmCalls = count(), inputTokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), outputTokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), by:{agent = service.name} | fieldsAdd totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens, inOutRatio = round(toDouble(inputTokens) / outputTokens, decimals: 1), avgInputPerCall = round(toDouble(inputTokens) / llmCalls) | sort totalTokens desc

md-tools.content:
## 2 · Find unused tools — every granted tool is billed on every prompt
Compare each agent's **granted** `toolNames` (in `agents/**/**.yaml`) against the tools it **actually calls** below. Tools never called are pure input-token overhead on every request — drop them.

distinct-tools.title: Distinct tools actually used (per agent)
distinct-tools.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool" and gen_ai.tool.name != "(merged tools)" | summarize distinctToolsUsed = countDistinct(gen_ai.tool.name), by:{agent = service.name} | sort distinctToolsUsed desc

tools-table.title: Tools called (by agent)
tools-table.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool" and gen_ai.tool.name != "(merged tools)" | summarize calls = count(), by:{agent = service.name, tool = gen_ai.tool.name} | sort agent asc, calls desc

md-loops.content:
## 3 · Find inefficient loops — multi-hop tasks re-send the same context
Each row is one agent task. A high `llmCalls` count with large `inputTokens` means the agent looped, re-sending its (bloated) context on every hop. Collapse the hops that don't earn their tokens.

loops-table.title: Tasks with ≥5 LLM hops (ranked by input tokens)
loops-table.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and span.name == "call_llm" | summarize llmCalls = count(), inputTokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), by:{agent = service.name, task = gen_ai.task.id} | filter llmCalls >= 5 | sort inputTokens desc | limit 25

md-trend.content: ## Token spend trend — watch for drift after each change

trend.title: Tokens over time by agent
trend.query: fetch spans | filter service.namespace == "kagent" and isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) | fieldsAdd totalTok = gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens | makeTimeseries tokens = sum(totalTok), by:{service.name}
